ledger_updates.subject: thm-nrqm-controlled-dynamics-airy-envelopes-and-asymptotic-coefficients
ledger_updates.correction: Read the entire cited Airy-contour proof 3.1: it explicitly derives the Fresnel/Fourier formula for arbitrary smooth compact transformed amplitude b, with remainder bounded by lambda^-1 times its finite Fourier second moment, and explicitly handles amplitudes 1 and s. For B's single stationary point s=1, phi=-2/3+v^2/2 and b(0)=1/sqrt(2); taking the imaginary part gives cos Theta and the real differentiated amplitude gives sin Theta. Restoring sqrt(Z) or Z yields errors Z^-7/4 and Z^-5/4. Nonstationary endpoint integration gives -1/(pi Z) and -1/(pi Z^2), canceled by E(-Z) and E'(-Z). Positive Laplace errors, entire ODE, constant Wronskian and positive A lower envelope also check. The estimate is actually proved in the named supplier, so no edit is licensed.
